name: gtcrn-characterization-v1
scope: Fixed-fixture whole-model characterization; no optimization or framework promotion
run_order: native then torch in even blocks; torch then native in odd blocks
case_order: Rotate the listed four cases by block index
primary: Equally weighted four-case geometric mean of paired torch/native completed pipeline wall latency ratios
uncertainty: Seeded paired-block bootstrap, exploratory only; a single execution cannot establish promotion

memory.host: GNU time maximum RSS in KiB for the complete fresh worker command, including setup and output I/O
memory.cuda: Separate fresh worker replay, sampled NVML compute-process-group memory; sampled high-water lower bound, not exact allocator peak

profiling.cpu: perf record, cycles:u, 199 Hz, DWARF call stacks; own process only
profiling.cuda: nsys CUDA trace, no CPU sampling or context-switch tracing
profiling.scope: Separate diagnostics and an uninstrumented same-count control; neither enters latency summaries

future_promotion.requirements: Fresh declared same-context candidate/control confirmation, licensed quality evaluation and complete memory/transfer accounting; retain existing operator champions
